parts.text: I will generate a professional lifestyle product photograph showcasing a premium health supplement bottle with a deep maroon and gold label. It will be the main focus, sharply in focus and slightly larger, positioned on a clean white marble countertop. Several prescription statin medication bottles will be placed slightly behind and to the side, softly blurred due to a shallow depth of field. Warm, natural morning light will illuminate the scene from the side, casting soft shadows. The background will be clean, minimal, and bright, consistent with high-end commercial product photography.
